topic.name: 中国与世界
topic.description: 关注中国经济、外交、安全、产业链与海外利益

overview: 今日专题“中国与世界”。共筛选 21 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: China-Cambodia drills: Type 071 warship offloads tanks overseas for the first time
featured.summary: China has for the first time sent its main battle tanks via an amphibious transport dock to Southeast Asia for a 15-day joint military exercise with Cambodia. The drills began on Wednesday at the Cambodia-China Joint Support and Training Centre, which opened early last year at Ream Port – a strategically located Cambodian naval base. The facility is expected to play a role as Beijing seeks to bypass maritime chokepoints and improve access to the Andaman Sea. Type 96A main battle tanks – one of...
featured.titleZh: 中柬联合军演：中国071型两栖船坞登陆舰首次在海外卸载坦克
featured.summaryZh: 中国首次通过两栖船坞登陆舰将主战坦克运往东南亚，参与在柬埔寨举行的联合军事演习。此次演习在云壤海军基地举行，旨在加强两国军事合作并提升中国在区域内的后勤保障能力。
featured.whyImportant: 此次部署展示了中国军队在海外投送重型装备能力的提升，具有重要的地缘政治意义。

featured.title: Abby Choi ‘not all good’ but nothing can justify ex-in-laws’ ‘brutality’, court hears
featured.summary: Slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung’s insensitive and inappropriate conduct did not justify her alleged murder and dismemberment at the hands of three of her former in-laws, prosecutors have said as they closed their case in the high-profile trial. Delivering her closing remarks in the High Court on Friday, prosecutor on fiat Charlotte Draycott SC warned the eight-member jury against over-analysing the alleged murder’s motive, noting the crime’s high premeditation was sufficient...
featured.titleZh: 法庭获悉：蔡天凤生前行为“并非完美”，但不足以成为前夫家“残暴行径”的借口
featured.summaryZh: 在香港名媛蔡天凤碎尸案的结案陈词中，检控官强调受害者的个人行为不能成为被告残忍杀害及肢解的理由。控方提醒陪审团关注案件的高度预谋性，而非纠结于动机。
featured.whyImportant: 此案因其极端的犯罪性质在香港社会引发了持续的法律与道德讨论。

featured.title: Hong Kong police handle 30 cybersecurity cases in past month, including AI-assisted hack
featured.summary: Hong Kong police have handled 30 cybersecurity incidents over the past month, with loopholes in communication mechanisms between software components accounting for a third of the cases. Superintendent Rachel Hui Yee-wai of the cybersecurity and technology crime bureau said her bureau had also handled a cybersecurity incident involving a local retail chain this month. In that case, an application programming interface (API) loophole caused over a million customers’ data to be leaked over a few...
featured.titleZh: 香港警方上月处理30起网络安全案件，包括人工智能辅助黑客攻击
featured.summaryZh: 香港警方网络安全及科技罪案调查科近期处理了30起网络安全事件，其中软件组件漏洞是主要原因之一。警方特别提到一起涉及本地零售连锁店的API漏洞事件，导致超过百万客户数据泄露。
featured.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了企业在数字化转型过程中面临日益严峻的网络安全威胁与数据保护挑战。

featured.title: Hong Kong’s top court quashes autistic man’s flag desecration conviction
featured.summary: An autistic man convicted of desecrating the China and Hong Kong flags in an incident when he was 19 was wrongly punished because “there was never sufficient evidence” to pursue a prosecution, the city’s top court ruled on Friday. The Court of Final Appeal quashed Wong Chun-lok’s conviction, with the judges lamenting that “a vulnerable member of the community was prosecuted for offences that he had not committed”. Wong was charged in 2023 with pulling down the flags and bending the metal...
featured.titleZh: 香港终审法院撤销一名自闭症男子侮辱国旗区旗的定罪
featured.summaryZh: 香港终审法院裁定，一名自闭症男子此前因侮辱国旗和区旗被定罪属于误判，因检控证据不足。法官对一名弱势群体成员被错误起诉表示遗憾，并最终撤销了其定罪。
featured.whyImportant: 此判决体现了司法系统对弱势群体权益的保障以及对证据标准的严格要求。

featured.summary: As the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit concluded in Shenzhen, one question rose above the diplomacy and symbolism: what does China’s growing global influence now require of it? For much of the past four decades, China’s paramount goal was integration. It sought access to markets, technology, investment and institutions to fuel its modernisation and development. featured.titleZh: 深圳的APEC遗产：中国从寻求认可到承担责任的转变
featured.summaryZh: 随着APEC峰会在深圳落幕，文章探讨了中国在全球影响力日益增强背景下的角色转变。中国已从过去追求市场准入和国际认可，转向在国际事务中承担更多责任。
featured.whyImportant: 该分析反映了中国在全球治理体系中地位变化及其对未来国际合作的影响。

featured.summary: Hong Kong’s Immigration Department has arrested a woman and her boyfriend for allegedly altering a travel document unlawfully after she took to social media to complain about a “manufacturing defect” in her passport that caused Japan’s authorities to deny her entry. The couple, who are aged between 27 and 34, were arrested on Thursday night from a public housing estate in Lam Tin on suspicion of unlawful alteration of a travel document and misleading the immigration service. The case came to...
featured.titleZh: 香港一对情侣因涉嫌篡改护照被捕
featured.summaryZh: 一名女子因护照“制造缺陷”导致无法入境日本而在社交媒体投诉，随后被香港入境处调查。她与其男友因涉嫌非法篡改旅行证件及误导入境处而被捕。
featured.whyImportant: 此案提醒公众篡改官方旅行证件属于严重刑事犯罪，将面临法律制裁。

featured.titleZh: 超越学位：香港教育大学荣誉学院如何为学生未来做好准备
featured.summaryZh: 随着人工智能重塑教育与职场，香港教育大学荣誉学院致力于培养学生批判性思考及适应变化的能力。该学院通过整合教育专业知识、前沿技术与实践经验，帮助学生应对未来的挑战。
featured.whyImportant: 该报道探讨了高等教育机构在人工智能时代如何通过创新课程提升毕业生的综合竞争力。

featured.title: Threat from China looms large over Taiwan’s local elections
featured.summary: Taiwanese officials raise alarm over interference by China in elections that will shape fortunes of ruling party Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party (DPP) as it navigates an increasingly precarious set of relationships on the global stage. Saturday’s vote will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts. Unlike the presidential elections, in which foreign policy is often a key issue, the local elections, held every four years, are largely focused on bread-and-butter issues such as housing affordability and wealth distribution. Continue reading...
featured.titleZh: 中国威胁笼罩台湾地方选举
featured.summaryZh: 台湾选民将于周六投票选出22个地区的地方领导人，此次选举结果将影响执政党民进党的未来。尽管选举主要关注住房和财富分配等民生议题，但官员们对中国干预选举表示担忧。
featured.whyImportant: 此次地方选举不仅关乎台湾内部民生政策，其受到的外部干预压力也引发了对地区政治局势的关注。

global.title: Houthi attacks test Saudi Arabia's image of security
global.summary: Despite the strikes, markets and restaurants in Riyadh remain busy as residents express trust in the government to protect them.
global.titleZh: 胡塞武装的袭击考验沙特阿拉伯的安全形象
global.summaryZh: 尽管遭受袭击，利雅得的市场和餐馆依然繁忙。当地居民表示，他们信任政府有能力保护其安全。
global.whyImportant: 此事件反映了沙特在面对地区安全威胁时，国内社会稳定与政府公信力所面临的考验。

global.title: Can the Mecca pact turn its collective defence promise into real support?
global.summary: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye meet in Islamabad as Houthi attacks on the kingdom continue and Iran talks stay open.
global.titleZh: 麦加协议能否将集体防御承诺转化为实际支持？
global.summaryZh: 随着胡塞武装对沙特的袭击持续，巴基斯坦、沙特和土耳其在伊斯兰堡举行会晤。与此同时，各方与伊朗的对话仍在进行中。
global.whyImportant: 该会晤旨在探讨地区国家如何通过集体防御机制应对日益严峻的安全挑战。

global.titleZh: 格蕾丝·塔姆公开谴责前默多克媒体高管，称其发表“一定又想被强奸”的言论
global.summaryZh: 默多克侄子马特·汉伯里承认曾对性侵幸存者格蕾丝·塔姆发表冒犯性言论。塔姆在听到该言论后当场与其对质，并随后撰文披露此事。
global.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于公众人物言论责任及对性暴力受害者尊重问题的广泛讨论。

global.title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
global.summary: It remains unclear who carried out the attack on Niger's National Guard in Tillaberi, near the Mali border.
global.titleZh: 尼日尔萨纳姆武装袭击造成至少13名士兵死亡
global.summaryZh: 尼日尔国民卫队在靠近马里边境的蒂拉贝里地区遭到袭击。目前尚不清楚袭击者的身份。
global.whyImportant: 该袭击凸显了萨赫勒地区持续存在的安全动荡和武装暴力威胁。

global.title: Banks may pass on £1.5bn tax rise on to customers, warns Bank of England chief
global.summary: Big lenders will aim to ‘protect their earnings’ amid temporary increase in corporation tax surcharge, says Andrew Bailey Business live – latest updates The governor of the Bank of England has warned that banks could look to pass on the £1.5bn cost of Labour’s increase to tax on their profits, a move that would put further pressure on household finances. John Healey, the chancellor, used his first budget last month to temporarily increase the bank corporation tax surcharge from 3% to 6% for a 15 month period from January, with the proceeds to be used to fund “breathing space” measures for households. global.titleZh: 英国央行行长警告：银行可能将15亿英镑的税收负担转嫁给客户
global.summaryZh: 英国央行行长贝利警告称，为应对企业税附加费的临时上调，大型银行可能会通过转嫁成本来保护利润。此举可能进一步加重家庭财务压力。
global.whyImportant: 银行的这一潜在举措可能抵消政府旨在缓解家庭生活成本压力的政策效果。

global.title: Zelenskyy warns of major Russian attack as Trump urges Putin to ‘pull back’
global.summary: Trump says he urged Putin to 'pull back' military aggression in Europe amid escalating Russian and Ukrainian attacks.
global.titleZh: 泽连斯基警告俄罗斯将发动大规模袭击，特朗普敦促普京“撤军”
global.summaryZh: 在俄乌双方袭击升级的背景下，特朗普表示已敦促普京停止在欧洲的军事侵略。泽连斯基则对俄罗斯即将发动的大规模袭击发出警告。
global.whyImportant: 美方领导人的介入与乌方的预警显示出俄乌冲突正处于高度紧张的升级阶段。

global.title: Global news agency AFP reports cyberattack, shuts down content platform
global.summary: France's cybersecurity chief urges collective action to combat unprecedented threat levels in the nation.
global.titleZh: 全球新闻机构法新社报告遭受网络攻击，关闭内容平台
global.summaryZh: 法新社遭遇网络攻击并被迫关闭内容平台。法国网络安全负责人呼吁采取集体行动，以应对国内前所未有的威胁水平。
global.whyImportant: 大型媒体机构遭受攻击凸显了全球范围内关键信息基础设施面临的网络安全风险。

global.titleZh: “绝对的混蛋”：西澳国家公园内500年树龄的“贾拉王”树遭电锯破坏，警方介入调查
global.summaryZh: 西澳大利亚当局正全力抢救位于惠灵顿国家公园内一棵拥有500年树龄的标志性贾拉树。该树疑似遭人恶意使用电锯破坏，警方已将其定性为刑事毁坏案件并呼吁公众提供线索。
global.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对保护珍稀自然遗产和严惩环境破坏行为的广泛关注。

items.titleZh: 2026年建筑创新博览会巩固香港作为全球建筑创新中心的地位
items.summaryZh: 随着香港建筑业产值预计到2030/31年度达到3600亿港元，行业正加速转型。香港建造业议会与发展局合作，旨在推动人工智能、机器人及模块化集成建筑等技术的应用。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过技术创新提升香港建筑业的生产力与国际竞争力，以应对未来庞大的市场需求。

items.titleZh: 莱拉·卡瓦贾谈黄仁勋事件如何重塑美中科技竞争
items.summaryZh: 研究主管莱拉·卡瓦贾在采访中探讨了英伟达CEO黄仁勋被解职又复职的事件。她分析了该事件及其他因素如何改变美中两国在科技领域的竞争格局。
